title: Application package shared definitions
description: Shared grammars for the Application Integration Package schemas (master plan section 9), referenced as urn:alixai:schema:application-package:defs:v1#/$defs/<name>. This file is a definitions library: it constrains nothing on its own. Patterns avoid lookahead so they behave the same in RE2 and ECMA-262 engines.

slug.title: Package-local identifier
slug.description: A lower-case identifier chosen by the package author for an endpoint, rule, outcome, term, source or similar object: starts with a letter, then letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, at most 64 characters.

dottedId.title: Dotted lower-snake identifier
dottedId.description: One to four dot-separated lower_snake segments, for example catalog.find_title or reservation.pickup_date. Used for capability IDs and for the paths of canonical facts in a deterministic result.

capabilityId.title: Capability ID
capabilityId.description: The stable ID of a capability: an exact-match common capability ID that is also a dotted lower-snake identifier. There are no wildcards.

factPath.title: Fact path
factPath.description: The dotted path of one canonical value in a deterministic result, for example reservation.pickup_date.

applicationId.title: Application ID
applicationId.description: The host application ID: a common identifier restricted to a portable slug, so it is safe in file names and logs. It is the application_id of every Scope the application's tokens carry.

docId.title: Documentation entry ID
docId.description: The ID of one documentation index entry: lower-case, starts with a letter, then letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, at most 64 characters. Unique across the whole index.

permissionId.title: Application permission ID
permissionId.description: The name of a permission the host application checks before it runs an operation (it reauthorizes every read, prepare and commit). Lower-case, may contain dot, colon, underscore and hyphen.

semver.title: Semantic version
semver.description: A semantic version 2.0.0 string: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional pre-release and build metadata.

languageTag.title: Language tag
languageTag.description: A BCP 47 tag in canonical case: a lower-case 2 or 3 letter language, an optional Title-case 4 letter script and an optional upper-case 2 letter or 3 digit region (en, it, pt-BR, zh-Hant-TW).

relativePath.title: Package-relative path
relativePath.description: A portable path inside the package: forward slashes only, no leading slash, no drive letter, no empty, '.' or '..' segment and no segment starting with a dot. Each segment starts with a letter, digit or underscore and continues with letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.

schemaRef.title: Reference to an application schema
schemaRef.description: A package-relative path below schemas/ with an optional JSON Pointer fragment (schemas/reservation.result.schema.json or schemas/openapi.yaml#/components/schemas/Reservation). It names a JSON Schema, an OpenAPI document or a similar machine-readable contract shipped in the package.

sha256.title: SHA-256 digest
sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

credentialRef.title: Credential reference
credentialRef.description: An opaque ID that names a credential held in the OS secret store or an approved local secret provider (master plan 16.2). It is never the credential: the cred: prefix, the lower-case-only alphabet and the 64-character cap exist so that a pasted key, token or password does not fit the grammar. AlixAI resolves it outside model context.

operationName.title: Adapter operation name
operationName.description: The name of one operation on an adapter: an MCP tool name, an OpenAPI operationId or a native bridge method name.

adapterCall.title: Adapter call
adapterCall.description: Names one operation on one declared endpoint. Exactly one of mcp_tool, openapi_operation_id or native_method is present; its kind must match the transport of the endpoint. There is no events variant: events never trigger an AI commit (master plan 9.3).

endpoint.description: The ID of an mcp, openapi or native endpoint declared in the manifest.

mcp_tool.description: MCP tool name, when the endpoint is an mcp endpoint.

openapi_operation_id.description: OpenAPI operationId, when the endpoint is an openapi endpoint.

native_method.description: Native bridge method name, when the endpoint is a native endpoint.

riskLevel.title: Risk level
riskLevel.description: The action safety level of master plan 11.4 as a bare integer: 0 read-only, 1 reversible low-impact, 2 consequential or external side effect, 3 high-risk, privileged or legally sensitive. Always required where it appears: the absence of a level is never read as 0. Mirrors pkg/contracts.RiskLevel.

errorCode.title: Error code
errorCode.description: A code of the platform error taxonomy (schemas/common/error.schema.json).

hostname.title: Exact host name
hostname.description: A lower-case DNS host name or IPv4 address, exact: no wildcard, no scheme, no port, no path.

httpUrl.title: HTTP(S) URL
httpUrl.description: An absolute http or https URL without user information (credentials never travel in a URL; use a credential reference).

label.title: Label
label.description: A single-line human-readable label: 1 to 200 characters, no control characters.

text.title: Text
text.description: Human-readable prose: 1 to 2000 characters. Line breaks and tabs are allowed; other control characters are not.

template.title: Response template
template.description: Fixed wording with {fact.path} placeholders that AlixAI fills from deterministic facts: the canonical values of an operation result, or, under the reserved prefix input., the validated field values collected so far (for example {input.query}). 1 to 1000 characters. Literal braces are written {{ and }}. A result placeholder must name a fact the capability declares in its response_obligations or result schema; an input placeholder must name one of its fields.

scalar.title: Scalar example value
scalar.description: A single value used in a test-only example.

exampleValue.title: Example value
exampleValue.description: A scalar, a flat list of scalars or a flat object of scalars. No deeper nesting.

exampleFields.title: Example field values
exampleFields.description: Field values keyed by capability field name.

retentionDays.title: Retention in days
retentionDays.description: A whole number of days, 0 to 3650. 0 means the data is not retained beyond the operation that needs it.

globPattern.title: Relative glob pattern
globPattern.description: A glob relative to a source root: no leading slash, no backslash, no '..' segment, at most 256 characters. * matches within a segment and ** across segments.

mimeType.title: MIME type
mimeType.description: A concrete lower-case media type such as text/markdown or application/pdf. No wildcards and no parameters.
